board_name: Odisha School Board Ecosystem (BSE Odisha & CHSE Odisha)

BSE.name: Board of Secondary Education, Odisha
BSE.jurisdiction: Secondary Education (Class 9 Academic Support & Class 10 High School Certificate Examination)

CHSE.name: Council of Higher Secondary Education, Odisha
CHSE.jurisdiction: Higher Secondary Education (Class 11 +2 1st Year Foundation & Class 12 +2 2nd Year Annual Examination)

class_9.examination_status: Annual School-Level Internal Assessment & Official BSE Odisha Advance Registration
class_9.service_type: Academic Foundation, Continuous Evaluation, Advance Student Registration for Matric

progression_to_class_10.rule: Progression to Class 10 requires qualifying the school-based Class 9 annual assessment under BSE Odisha Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation guidelines and completing the official BSE candidate registration.

class_10.examination_name: High School Certificate (HSC) Examination / Annual Matric Examination
class_10.service_type: Public Secondary Board Examination, Verified Practice, Model Papers & Revision Compendiums

examination_schedule_and_duration.standard_hours: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM (2 hours 30 minutes; Mathematics 2 hours 45 minutes)

core_academic_subjects.name: General Science (Bhoutika Bigyan o Jiba Bigyan)
Social Science (Itihasa, Rajaniti Bigyan, Bhugola o Arthaniti)

class_10.scheme_of_examination: 6 Compulsory Subjects (First Language, Second Language, Third Language, Mathematics, General Science, Social Science). Each subject carries 100 Marks (80 Marks Summative Board Examination: 50 MCQs OMR + 30 Subjective Written + 20 Marks Internal Formative Assessment). Total: 600 Marks.

special_examinations.single_subject_odia: BSE Odisha conducts Half-Yearly / Annual Single Subject Examination in Odia (Class X standard) for in-service candidates and job aspirants.

class_11.examination_status: +2 First Year Foundation & SAMS Sourced Enrolment
class_11.service_type: Council-Monitored Institutional Assessment, Stream Selection, SAMS Online Registration

progression_to_class_12.rule: Promotion to Class 12 (+2 2nd Year) requires passing Class 11 annual internal college examination and maintaining minimum 75% attendance in theory and practicals.

class_12.examination_name: Annual Higher Secondary Examination (AHSE) / +2 Second Year Examination
class_12.service_type: Public Higher Secondary Board Examination, Stream Specialization, Full Exam Simulator & Practice
class_12.scheme_of_examination: Total 6 Subjects (2 Compulsory Languages: English + MIL; 3 Compulsory Electives; 1 Optional 4th Elective). Each subject carries 100 Marks (Lab subjects: 70 Theory + 30 Practical; Non-lab subjects: 80 Theory + 20 Project/Internal). Total Marks: 600.

passing_criteria.grading_system: Division 1 (>= 60%), Division 2 (45% to < 60%), Division 3 (33% to < 45%). Fail (< 33%).
